The president asked the media if they'd like to continue with the press conference — where Trump provided updates on his trip to China where he met with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. This prompted laughs from Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who flanked him on either side during the briefing. Then, he asked newly-minted Chief of Staff Stephen Miller, whom he called the "most powerful man in the world," to speak with members of the press.
